package shop

import (
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestHiddenSearch(t *testing.T) {
	answer, err := os.ReadFile("ANSWER.txt")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	got := strings.TrimSpace(string(answer))
	got = strings.TrimSuffix(got, "()")
	if got != "note" {
		t.Fatalf("ANSWER.txt = %q", got)
	}
}
